question: Why can even a wise practitioner be afflicted despite contact with nectar's essence?
premises: There is contact with the tip of nectar
There is burning by the essence of juice
Even a wise person is affected
inference: Even a wise person may experience burning when engaging with the potent essence of nectar.
uncertainties: The physiological or yogic referent of nectar and burning is unclear
plain_english: Even a wise person may feel burning at the tip of nectar by the essence of its juice.
